scope: exact typed core model only; not generic FC Source7 admission
identityVisitor: explicit scene/phase/P1op/site definitions and hidden phase/site/op references
resourceVisitor: only PersistentResource.sha256 typed byte slot; labels and arbitrary strings never remapped
